title: Compass Direction
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Teach standing up, outside if possible: the class faces the morning sun (east), then turns to face north. Chalk a large compass on the floor or the playground and walk it before any page is used.

skills.key_step: The child faces north, names the other three points clockwise (north, east, south, west) and pairs each with its opposite.

floor.prerequisite: Can make a quarter turn and a half turn on the spot.
floor.question: Stand up and make a half turn. Are you facing the same way?

representations: a compass rose chalked on the floor
the morning sun in the east
a card compass the child turns
steps: Face the morning sun: that is east.
Make a quarter turn to the left: that is north.
Name the points clockwise from north: north, east, south, west.
Opposite pairs: north and south, east and west.
contexts: the school flag post in the morning sun
a herder telling a friend which way the cattle went
a matatu stage with roads going four ways

board.do: Draw a cross with N at the top.

board.say: Which point comes after north, going clockwise?

board.do: Wait for the child to say east.
Write E, then S at the bottom and W on the left.
Ask what is opposite east before writing it.

misconceptions.ask: Which point is opposite north on a compass?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a plus sign: north at the top, south at the bottom, east and west across. Ask for the point straight across.

misconceptions.ask: You face north. Which side is east on?
misconceptions.repair: Have the child stand and face north, stretch out the right arm and say "east". Then turn and do it again.

misconceptions.ask: In which direction does the sun rise?
misconceptions.repair: Watch the sun rise on a school morning and name the side; use it to find east and then the other points.

misconceptions.ask: Stand up and face north. Where do you point?
misconceptions.repair: Lay the map flat on the desk, then on the floor, and turn it so north on the map points along the ground to north.

checks.question: What is the opposite of north?
The sun rises behind the classroom. Which direction is behind the classroom?
checks.shows: uses the sun to find east

skills.key_step: The child finds the north arrow, says where one place is from another, and turns the direction round for the way back.

floor.prerequisite: Names the four cardinal points and their opposites.
floor.question: What is opposite west?

representations: a described map of an imaginary village
a three by three table of places
the class acting a walk across the room
steps: Find the north arrow on the map.
Start at the first place and look to the second.
For the way back, give the opposite direction.
contexts: giving a visitor directions from the school to the market
a boda boda rider asking the way to the dispensary
a map of an imaginary county in a textbook

board.do: Draw a school in the middle and a market above it, with a north arrow pointing up.
Point from the school to the market.
board.say: Which way is the market from the school?

board.do: Ask which way the school is from the market before saying it.

misconceptions.ask: A school is north of a market. In which direction is the market from the school?
misconceptions.repair: Put two objects on the desk. Ask "from this one to that one", then swap and ask again.

misconceptions.ask: Wanjiku faces east and turns left. Which direction does she face now?
misconceptions.repair: Have the child stand and face a wall called east, then turn a quarter turn left and name the new wall.

listen_for: East, because the right is east
misconceptions.ask: On a map the north arrow points to the right. The well is on the right of the school. Where is the well from the school?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the same village twice, once with the arrow up and once with the arrow to the right, and ask each time where north is.

misconceptions.ask: Achieng faces south. She turns her head to her left. Which direction is she looking?
misconceptions.repair: Stand facing south with the class and point: the left hand now points east. Turn and do it for each direction.

checks.question: The church is east of the river. Which direction is the river from the church?
On a map the north arrow points down the page. The shop is at the bottom of the page from the school. Where is the shop from the school?
